title: Zhihuai
wikitext:
{{Stub|Do you need to complete [[Listen to Animals' Words: Translation of Cat's Language]] questline to have Translation Module option?}} {{NPC Infobox |image = .png |type = Event |nation = Lahai-Roi |location = Startorch Academy |location2 = Rabelle College |group = Roya Tribe |affiliation = |title = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an event-exclusive NPC for the {{Quest|Gold Suspended in Shadows}} during the {{Extra Effect|New Solar Celebration|New Solar Celebration|The Exostrider poured forth light and heat from its Reactor Drive, sheltering life from the killing frost. Grateful for this gift, the Roya revered the Reactor Drive as their sun. They took it upon themselves to gather the Exostrider's "cells," making this quiet labor the duty of their tribe.
Now, their ancient vow is complete. As the new sun rises, they hold the New Solar Celebration, both to mark the renewal and to remind their kin of the purpose that set them on this path.}}. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} :;'''Lumy:''' Aww, what a lovely little kitty! Look how comfortable it is around people. :;'''Zhihuai:''' Cute, right? Feeling jealous? Well, you should, cuz this is our club's honorary member. :;'''Stig:''' Is it true cat's toe beans taste like chocolate...? ;Interact with the cat :'''Cat:''' Meow, meow... meow. :The cat elegantly licks its paw and shows you its soft, furry belly. :{{DIcon}} Pet its belly. ::The cat is startled at first, but succumbs to your superior cat-petting technique and quickly starts purring again. ::'''Zhihuai:''' Wow, most people who go straight for the belly usually get the teeth. No wonder you're famous around the Academy. You're quite the cat-petting pro. :{{DIcon}} Pet its head. ::The cat accepts your petting, its warm head nuzzling and rubbing against your palm. ::'''Zhihuai:''' Isn't Malma a sweetie? :{{DIcon}} Play with it with the toy over there. ::The cat is delighted and immediately starts playing with you. ::'''Zhihuai:''' It's Malma's favorite toy. I always bring it along with her wherever I go. :'''Zhihuai:''' Malma is very smart and has a good temper. I was worried that traveling across the ocean with me might stress her out at first, but turns out she's not scared at all. :'''Lumy:''' I've been following the club's socials! They sometimes post Malma's daily routine, and just a single glance is enough to heal me from a long day of work. :'''Lumy:''' I heard the club is planning to have Malma do a meet & greet with fans during the Celebration, so I got here as fast as I could! :'''Stig:''' I wasn't a big cat-person before… and I wasn't very good at taking care of one either. :'''Stig:''' Fortunately, Malma takes good care of herself. Aside from the usual hide-and-seek, she's trouble-free. Before meeting her, I thought all cats were home destroyers… :'''Zhihuai:''' Playfulness is part of a cat's nature. There's no need to worry, Stig. :'''Zhihuai:''' We plan to have her come out and meet everyone more often, even after the Celebration. Oh, it's a call from our leader. Mind looking after Malma for a little while, Stig? :'''Zhihuai:'''M-Me? Okay. :'''Zhihuai:''' Aw, here I was hoping to chat with you, {{Rover}}. Guess I'll see you next time. :{{DIcon}} See you. :'''With that, Zhihuai hurries away.''' ---- ;Interact with the cat :'''Malma:''' Meow— :The cat greets you warmly. :{{DIcon}} Use the [[Listen to Animals' Words: Translation of Cat's Language|Translation Module]] to interpret the language. ::'''Malma (Translation):''' Hello, you look very much like my kind. ::'''Rover:''' ...? :{{DIcon}} No idea what it's saying, but pet it anyway. ::'''Malma:''' Purr purr… ::You realize that one day you'll be able to make all cats purr for you, and you're filled with determination. :{{DIcon}} Leave. ::'''Malma:''' Meow? ::The cat watches as you leave. Cats are free animals, and the cat hopes you are too. ---- :{{Icon/Quest|Side Quests}} [[Cat-Finding Master]] :;'''Lumy:''' Have you searched the area? :;'''Stig:''' Yeah, I've looked everywhere and haven't seen Malma anywhere. :;'''Lumy:''' Where could she have run off to... I'm so worried... ;'''Zhihuai:''' Malma! Malma—Where are you— ;'''Zhihuai:''' Malma! Please don't get llost in this big and bustling Celebration! :'''Zhihuai:''' {{Rover}}! Sigh, I said I hoped to have a proper chat with you, but not under these circumstances. :{{DIcon}} What's wrong? :'''Zhihuai:''' Malma's gone missing. :{{DIcon}} Malma's missing? :'''Zhihuai:''' Yep, that's the situation we're in… :'''Stig:''' It's all my fault for not keeping an eye on Malma. :'''Zhihuai:''' It wasn't your fault. Here's the thing, {{Rover}}. Malma likes being around people, but she also likes to pick on Stig. :'''Zhihuai:''' I'm guessing she's playing hide-and-seek with Stig, but she's been gone for so long, and I'm getting worried something might've happened to her… :'''Lumy:''' Sob... There're so many people in the venue. Do you think someone might've catnapped her? :'''Lumy:''' She's so adorable... How can someone beat me to it! :'''Stig:''' ? :'''Zhihuai:''' This isn't the time for jokes, Lumy... :'''Zhihuai:''' I still need to cover the booth. Could you help us look for Malma? There will be a reward if you find her! :{{DIcon}} Leave it to me. :{{DIcon}} [[Save the World? Save the Cat!|Finding cats]] is my specialty. :'''Zhihuai:''' That's great! Malma is a chatty cat and never holds back on her meows. :'''Zhihuai:''' Just look anywhere you hear cat noises, and you'll find Malma eventually! :'''Zhihuai:''' Malma loves to meow, so follow the cat noises, and your chances of finding her are pretty good. :'''Zhihuai:''' I'm counting on you, {{Rover}}! ---- :;You're here! Welcome! :;'''Zig''' I'm thinking about adopting a cat too... :;A kitty! You can have cats in your club? Are you still recruiting? :;'''Zhihuai''' Sure. We welcome new members anytime, and those who join during the Celebration get surprise gifts! :;'''Stig''' Welcome to the club. Please fill out the form here. ;After completing [[Cat-Finding Master]] :'''Zhihuai:''' Actually, this isn't the first time Malma has run away, but most of the time we can't find her, and all we can do is just wait for her to come back on her own. :'''Zhihuai:''' I thought with {{Rover}}'s reputation on our side, it was worth a shot. I didn't expect you actually find her! :'''Zhihuai:''' If Malma runs away again next time, could I ask you to help find her? :{{DIcon}} As long as it comes with rewards. ::'''Zhihuai:''' Haha, of course, it does! In Huanglong, honesty is our specialty. :{{DIcon}} Absolutely. ::'''Zhihuai:''' Don't worry, I won't let you go to all that trouble for nothing. I'll always have rewards ready for you. :'''Zhihuai:''' As for the meal we talked about last time, the offer still stands. Come by and play whenever you're free! ---- ;Interact with the cat :'''Malma:''' Meow—" :The cat greets you warmly. :{{DIcon}} Use the Translation Module to interpret the language. ::'''Malma:''' That hide-and-seek yesterday was so much fun. I'll give them a real scare next time. ::'''Rover:''' Sigh... :{{DIcon}} No idea what it's saying, but pet it anyway. ::'''Malma:''' Purr purr… ::Malma slowly licks your hand. It kind of tickles. :{{DIcon}} Play with it with the cat toy. ::'''Malma:''' Meow, meow… meow, meow, meow! ::Faced with the toy, with piercing eyes and perfect posture, the cat unleashes its signature move! :{{DIcon}} Leave. ::'''Malma:''' Meow? ::The cat watches as you leave. Cats are free animals, and the cat hopes you are too. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Isabella |zhs = |zht = |ja = |ko = |es = |fr = |de = |th = |pt = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.2}}
